metaDescription: 24 diamonds · 18.20 ct total · five cuts: Round Brilliant, Oval, Pear, Emerald, Cushion. One unbroken thought on the wrist. Bez Ambar, Los Angeles.
copy: Twenty-four stones. Eighteen point twenty carats. No two cuts identical. Round Brilliant, Oval, Pear, Emerald, Cushion — five cuts, each chosen for its unique relationship to light. No two positions on this bracelet read the same. The sequence is intentional: a continuous grammar of form from clasp to clasp. Together, they form a sentence. One unbroken thought, worn on the wrist.
